archetypes.name: dyn-ledger-recovery
archetypes.rationale: Ledger idempotency and retry semantics are central to the new mutating skill.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/rejected_analysis.py with emphasis on ledger writes, ingest-status staging, launch-failed retryability, and record-time mapping from issue-cluster-map.json. Check that terminal dispositions are persisted exactly once and that confirmed hashes are not marked filed when /issue output is partial or unmapped. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-skill-orchestrator
archetypes.rationale: The prompt-side SKILL.md coordinates external launchers and /issue filing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review skills/rejected-analysis/SKILL.md and the wrapper for orchestration risks. Focus on Bash fence KV rebinding, read-only launch-review flags, dirty-tree sidecar handling, sentinel clearing, child /issue continuation, and the always-run record step after failures. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
